assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original cinematic game landscape background for a mature survival exploration sample named After the Rain. Paint an abandoned mountain valley after a rainstorm, mist layered through tall dark spruce forest, broken timber cabins beside a cold winding stream, wet gravel, amber light from a tiny surviving camp, distant mountains under blue grey storm clouds. Premium hand-painted environment art, grounded proportions, detailed material surfaces and atmospheric depth, restrained desaturated pine green, slate blue and worn ochre, hopeful but tense. Wide landscape 3:2 composition, high oblique overhead camera to suggest the playable valley rather than a close portrait. No characters in foreground, no user interface, no labels, no text, no logos, no frame, no watermark. This is a world illustration used only as introductory art; it must look painted by an environment artist rather than diagrammatic or geometrical.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game terrain texture atlas, original mature rainy wilderness survival game. Order left to right top row: damp mossy dark pine forest grass, wet compacted gravel walking path, muddy puddled loam, rough grey mountain granite. Bottom row: weathered dark timber planks, translucent blue slate river water with delicate flowing highlights, mossy abandoned concrete slab, pine needle earth with small scattered roots. Every square maintains a consistent scale, no large objects, no buildings, no trees, no symbols, no UI, no text, no 3D cubes, no perspective tile diagrams, no shadows from unseen objects. All eight tiles must remain useful as actual repeatable game ground materials.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production transparent sprite atlas for a mature hand-painted wilderness survival game. Camera is consistent high oblique 3/4 overhead at about 55 degrees, orthographic, viewer sees roof/top and small front sides. Row1 left to right: tall dark spruce tree; weathered ruined timber cabin with crooked slate roof; abandoned rusty small pickup truck with a crate in its bed; iron hand water pump and a battered blue barrel. Row2: short wooden radio mast with antenna and equipment box; UNLIT stone fire ring with dry logs but NO flame; a practical pitched canvas tarp shelter between poles with bedroll; bundled stack of split firewood. Row3: enamel water purification pot on a simple metal stand; opened empty supply crate; cut tree stump with fallen branch; large natural granite boulder with moss. Actual transparent alpha everywhere outside objects and their soft shadows; no grey/checkerboard background drawn into image. No words, no labels, no grid lines, no UI, no border, no watermark. Aim wide 4:3 atlas layout with evenly spaced cells.
